sheets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce ONE finished whole-character hand-painted 2D animation cel. Image 1 is the edit target, the exact right-profile character from Image 2. Follow its palette, exact face, head silhouette, jaw, nose, hair, outfit, belt line, shoulder width, hip profile and boot. Keep the EXACT straight right-facing side camera, no turning toward viewer, same slim standing posture, same width, proportions, existing raised collar, case and bag, same right-foot baseline. Match its deep, subdued dusty purple and brown matte light; no new highlights, rim lights or stylization. Change only the arms and the nearby clothing required for this new pose.
Pose: he is thinking. His anatomical RIGHT arm is the nearest one. At the near shoulder a single continuous slate-taupe cloth sleeve comes from UNDER the edge of the short indigo mantle, then bends at its visible elbow near the chest; that SAME wrapped right forearm rises in front of the cloak seam toward the chin. The right fingerless glove is seen in profile as a small loose fist, two knuckles gently touch the bottom-forward corner of the jaw, the face clear. Anatomical LEFT arm is the far one, its shoulder and upper-arm root are hidden BY the chest and cloak. Its single foreshortened wrapped forearm folds BACK across the lower chest from the far elbow in front of the torso. Seen just below and behind the near arm, the far gloved palm visibly cups the near right elbow from below, with a tiny visible thumb tip. Clearly different arms. Natural elbow shapes, wrists in line with each forearm, no fused arms, no severed sleeves, hanging hand, new strap, third arm or disconnected fragments. Resolve where cape, arms and cuffs overlap with deliberate, crisp silhouette edges and soft painted surfaces. Draw only one fully resolved cel, no labels, text or graphic elements; no cards, effects, paper, floor or shadows. True transparent alpha. Full figure and complete boot, breathing room around the figure.

Use case: precise-object-edit. FOUR individual traditional painted animation drawings of the SAME character in four moments, arranged in a strict TWO by TWO grid, with each drawing in its own quadrant. View each as a COMPLETE upper-body cel from crown to just below the two belts and top of leather case. Include BOTH arms inside the picture, all hair and fingertips, wide transparent gutters. Both references are for this exact young man. Image 1 is the animation master for angle, spacing, subdued dusty-purple palette and folds. Image 2 is the approved character design. Keep strict screen RIGHT-facing PROFILE, same untouched face (eye ear jaw and nose), crown, shoulder shape and clothing design, same oblique brown strap, plain wraps, dark fingerless gloves, sleeve width and same belt/case reference points. Do not change angle or light. Muted diffuse lavender-brown light, hand-painted matte planes and soft value contrasts. No 3D render or shiny treatment. Draw the arms as part of the whole pose. His NEAR right sleeve comes out from under the forward corner of the violet mantle. Only its near forearm can cross in front of that edge. Far shoulder hidden naturally behind the torso. His FAR left forearm stays folded across lower ribs, clearly separated from near elbow and face. In active poses its palm rests visibly against his own sternum. Don't draw redundant cuffs, extra hanging arm or detached fingers. Never draw fake penumbra. True transparent only; no cards, text, numbers, guide lines, frame border, boxes, ground or drop shadows.
Top LEFT: held GESTURE from master exactly, near right forearm almost upright and right knuckles gently under chin, far left palm supporting the near bent elbow FROM BELOW. Top RIGHT: the first moving drawing, the right knuckles have lifted a little forward of the chin by about 1 finger width; the near elbow rises just slightly away from the far palm, which begins to lower. Bottom LEFT: preparing the finger flick, right thumb visibly pins the pad of the curled right index. Right fist is a third of a face-width ahead of the chin and slightly lower, near elbow begins to point forward, far left palm is lowering to the ribs. Bottom RIGHT: right elbow opens halfway toward a MIDDLE target, wrist ahead of nose at chest height; loaded curled index still pressed to thumb; right hand structurally continuous with cloth forearm; the far left forearm folded across the waist, creating negative space between the right knee-like elbow and left palm. Deliberate changes in silhouette but constant face, waist and camera.
